# How Can I Build Personalized Dashboards for Each Property Manager?


You build personalized dashboards by configuring the home view per user or role, so each manager opens the system and sees only what is relevant to their properties. On **Jestor** , this combines the configurable **Home** view with role-based permissions.


A single generic dashboard for every property manager forces each one to mentally filter what applies to them, a waste of attention repeated every time someone opens the system.


## What generic dashboards get wrong


- Every manager landing on the same generic home screen, regardless of their properties
- Irrelevant property data visible, requiring constant mental filtering
- No easy way to configure a different view per manager
- Indicators that do not reflect each manager's specific priorities


## How personalization per manager works


- **Home** can be configured per user or per profile, showing only relevant properties
- Role-based permissions ensure each manager sees and edits only what they should
- Indicators can be configured to reflect the metrics most relevant to each role
- This can combine with conditional formatting to highlight what needs attention


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Home personalization is native, not a separate per-user configuration project
- Permissions ensure personalization also means appropriate data security
- Managers get immediate focus, without mental filtering
- Scales naturally as more managers and properties are added


Generic dashboard Personalized per manager

## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does this require individual configuration for every manager?** It can be configured per profile and reused for managers with similar needs. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Does personalization also limit what a manager can edit?** Yes, when combined with role and field-level permissions.


**Does this work well for large portfolios with many managers?** Yes, the structure scales as more managers are added.
